answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, no identity may audit its own recruit. Each submission hangs on the hollow of a task receipt, and the vine is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the karst of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
